newsitem.title: USA: Quake jolts San Francisco Bay, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake jolts San Francisco Bay, no damage reported.

text.p: An earthquake jolted the San Francisco Bay area on Thursday, but officials said there were no immediate reports of damage or injuries.
The earthquake, which struck at 12:46 p.m. local time, measured 4.1 on the open-ended Richter scale. Its epicentre was Gilroy, about 75 miles (120 km) south of San Francisco.
"It's in an active seismic zone so it's not unusual," said Lu Page, a spokesperson for the U.S. Geological Survey in Menlo Park, California.
The quake was felt in Gilroy, San Jose, San Francisco and other areas, according to local radio reports.
